---
title: "Leadership Dashboard"
subtitle: "All Faculty & Fellows — Department of Internal Medicine"
params:
  faculty_rds: ""    # path to pre-fetched faculty RDS (passed by render scripts)
  rdm_rds: ""        # path to pre-fetched RDM RDS
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    theme: flatly
    page-layout: full
    toc: true
    toc-location: left
    toc-title: "Contents"
    toc-depth: 2
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

source(here::here("R/utils/data_processing.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils/calculations.R"))
source(here::here("R/utils/plot_functions.R"))

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (nchar(params$faculty_rds) > 0 && file.exists(params$faculty_rds)) {
  faculty_data <- readRDS(params$faculty_rds)
  rdm_data     <- readRDS(params$rdm_rds)
} else if (Sys.getenv("PRODUCTION_MODE") == "TRUE") {
  faculty_data <- download_faculty_data()
  rdm_data     <- download_rdm_focused()
} else {
  td           <- load_test_data()
  faculty_data <- td$faculty
  rdm_data     <- td$rdm
}

# ── Division label map ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DIV_LABELS <- c(
  "1"  = "Addiction Medicine",   "2"  = "Allergy",
  "3"  = "Cardiology",           "4"  = "Endocrinology",
  "5"  = "Gastroenterology",     "6"  = "Geriatrics",
  "7"  = "GIM - Hospitalist",    "8"  = "GIM - Primary Care",
  "9"  = "Hematology / Oncology","10" = "Infectious Disease",
  "11" = "Nephrology",           "12" = "Palliative Care",
  "13" = "Pulmonary / Critical Care", "14" = "Rheumatology",
  "15" = "Other"
)

# ── Domain label map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DOMAIN_MAP <- c(
  "approachability" = "Approachability",
  "respect"         = "Respect",
  "bedside_manner"  = "Bedside Manner",
  "time_teaching"   = "Time for Teaching",
  "ques_clin_des"   = "Clinical Reasoning",
  "autonomy"        = "Autonomy",
  "feedback"        = "Feedback",
  "organ"           = "Organization"
)

# ── All active faculty and fellows ────────────────────────────────────────────
pd_people <- faculty_data |>
  filter(
    archived == 0 | is.na(archived),
    record_id != 1,
    !is.na(fac_name), nchar(trimws(fac_name)) > 0,
    !fac_name %in% c("Pending", "pending")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    fac_name      = clean_faculty_names(fac_name),
    fac_div       = as.character(fac_div),
    div_label     = coalesce(DIV_LABELS[fac_div], paste0("Division ", fac_div)),
    fac_meded_fte = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fac_meded_fte)),
    person_type   = if_else(fac_fell == 2, "Fellow", "Faculty", missing = "Faculty")
  ) |>
  arrange(div_label, person_type, fac_name)

all_person_names <- pd_people$fac_name

current_year <- get_current_academic_year()

# ── Eval & assessment data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fac_eval <- rdm_data$faculty_evaluation |>
  mutate(
    fac_fell_name   = clean_faculty_names(fac_fell_name),
    att_overall     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(att_overall)),
    approachability = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(approachability)),
    respect         = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(respect)),
    bedside_manner  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bedside_manner)),
    time_teaching   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(time_teaching)),
    ques_clin_des   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ques_clin_des)),
    autonomy        = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(autonomy)),
    feedback        = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(feedback)),
    organ           = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(organ))
  )

assessment <- rdm_data$assessment |>
  mutate(ass_faculty = clean_faculty_names(ass_faculty))

# Current-year evals and assessments (all people)
all_person_evals_curr <- fac_eval |>
  filter(fac_fell_name %in% all_person_names) |>
  filter_by_academic_year(date_col = "fac_eval_date", year = current_year)

all_person_assess_curr <- assessment |>
  filter(ass_faculty %in% all_person_names) |>
  filter_by_academic_year(date_col = "ass_date", year = current_year)

# ── Summary stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_people       <- nrow(pd_people)
n_fellows      <- sum(pd_people$person_type == "Fellow")
n_faculty      <- sum(pd_people$person_type == "Faculty")
n_total_evals  <- nrow(all_person_evals_curr)
n_total_assess <- nrow(all_person_assess_curr)
dept_overall   <- if (n_total_evals > 0) round(mean(all_person_evals_curr$att_overall, na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA

# ── Per-division domain means (comparison baseline in expandable rows) ─────────
divisions_present <- unique(pd_people$fac_div[!is.na(pd_people$fac_div)])

div_means_all <- setNames(lapply(divisions_present, function(div) {
  div_names <- pd_people |> filter(fac_div == div) |> pull(fac_name)
  div_ev    <- all_person_evals_curr |> filter(fac_fell_name %in% div_names)
  if (nrow(div_ev) < MIN_EVALUATIONS) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(DOMAIN_MAP)), names(DOMAIN_MAP)))
  sapply(names(DOMAIN_MAP), function(d) {
    if (d %in% names(div_ev)) round(mean(div_ev[[d]], na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA_real_
  })
}), divisions_present)

# ── Assessment by resident level (dept-wide) ──────────────────────────────────
level_map <- c("1" = "Intern", "2" = "PGY-2", "3" = "PGY-3",
               "4" = "Graduated", "5" = "Rotator")

assess_by_level <- all_person_assess_curr |>
  filter(!is.na(ass_level)) |>
  mutate(level_label = level_map[as.character(ass_level)]) |>
  count(level_label) |>
  arrange(match(level_label, c("Intern", "PGY-2", "PGY-3", "Rotator", "Graduated")))

# ── Synthesis cache (Feedback on Your Feedback) ───────────────────────────────
synth_cache_path <- here::here("data", "synthesis_cache.rds")
synth_cache      <- if (file.exists(synth_cache_path)) readRDS(synth_cache_path) else NULL

get_synthesis_html <- function(nm) {
  if (is.null(synth_cache)) return(NULL)
  prefix   <- paste0(nm, "::synthesis_v3::")
  fac_keys <- names(synth_cache)[startsWith(names(synth_cache), prefix)]
  if (length(fac_keys) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Most-recent snapshot by date suffix in key
  date_suffix <- vapply(fac_keys, function(k) {
    parts     <- strsplit(k, "::", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    last_part <- parts[length(parts)]
    date_part <- sub(".*__", "", last_part)
    if (grepl("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$", date_part)) date_part else "0000-00-00"
  }, character(1))

  latest_key <- fac_keys[order(date_suffix, nchar(fac_keys), decreasing = TRUE)[1]]

  tryCatch({
    # PD view shows only the PD coaching note — not the full faculty-facing
    # synthesis (cards, themes, growth pointers). Requires attendfeedback.
    h <- attendfeedback::render_synthesis_pd_note_html(synth_cache[[latest_key]])
    if (is.null(h)) return(NULL)
    # unbox so toJSON emits a plain string (auto_unbox alone is not enough
    # for values built outside the list literal)
    jsonlite::unbox(paste0(as.character(h), collapse = ""))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# ── Per-person detail for expandable rows ─────────────────────────────────────
member_details <- setNames(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pd_people)), function(i) {
  row  <- pd_people[i, ]
  nm   <- row$fac_name
  div  <- row$fac_div

  ev   <- all_person_evals_curr  |> filter(fac_fell_name == nm)
  ass  <- all_person_assess_curr |> filter(ass_faculty   == nm)
  n_ev <- nrow(ev)

  div_means <- div_means_all[[div]]

  domain_list <- if (n_ev >= MIN_EVALUATIONS) {
    lapply(names(DOMAIN_MAP), function(d) list(
      label = unname(DOMAIN_MAP[d]),
      score = if (d %in% names(ev)) round(mean(ev[[d]], na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA,
      div   = if (!is.null(div_means)) unname(div_means[d]) else NA
    ))
  } else list()

  list(
    n_evals        = n_ev,
    avg_overall    = if (n_ev >= MIN_EVALUATIONS) round(mean(ev$att_overall, na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA,
    n_assess       = nrow(ass),
    division       = coalesce(row$div_label, "Unknown"),
    person_type    = row$person_type,
    has_domains    = n_ev >= MIN_EVALUATIONS,
    domains        = domain_list,
    plus           = as.list(ev |> filter(!is.na(plus),  nchar(trimws(plus))  > 0) |> pull(plus)),
    delta          = as.list(ev |> filter(!is.na(delta), nchar(trimws(delta)) > 0) |> pull(delta)),
    synthesis_html = get_synthesis_html(nm)
  )
}), pd_people$fac_name)

# null = "null" so a missing synthesis serializes as JSON null (falsy in JS),
# not {} (truthy) — {} made the Notes on Feedback section render "[object Object]"
detail_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(member_details, auto_unbox = TRUE,
                                na = "null", null = "null")

# ── Med Ed role mapping + per-person roles ────────────────────────────────────
get_meded_mapping <- function() {
  tryCatch({
    url   <- Sys.getenv("REDCAP_URL")
    token <- Sys.getenv("FAC_TOKEN")
    if (nchar(url) == 0 || nchar(token) == 0) return(NULL)
    result <- REDCapR::redcap_metadata_read(redcap_uri = url, token = token)
    if (!result$success) return(NULL)
    row <- result$data[result$data$field_name == "fac_med_ed", ]
    if (nrow(row) == 0) return(NULL)
    pairs  <- trimws(strsplit(row$select_choices_or_calculations[1], "\\|")[[1]])
    codes  <- sub(",.*", "", pairs) |> trimws()
    labels <- sub("^[^,]+,\\s*", "", pairs) |> trimws()
    setNames(labels, codes)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

meded_map  <- get_meded_mapping()
meded_cols <- grep("^fac_med_ed___", names(pd_people), value = TRUE)

meded_roles_vec <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(pd_people)), function(i) {
  row   <- pd_people[i, ]
  codes <- sub("^fac_med_ed___", "", meded_cols[
    sapply(meded_cols, function(col) isTRUE(as.integer(row[[col]]) == 1L))
  ])
  if (length(codes) == 0) return("")
  if (!is.null(meded_map)) {
    lbls <- meded_map[codes]
    lbls <- lbls[!is.na(lbls)]
    if (length(lbls) > 0) return(paste(unname(lbls), collapse = "; "))
  }
  paste(codes, collapse = "; ")
})

# ── Summary table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fellow_summary <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(pd_people)), function(i) {
  row <- pd_people[i, ]
  nm  <- row$fac_name
  ev  <- all_person_evals_curr  |> filter(fac_fell_name == nm)
  ass <- all_person_assess_curr |> filter(ass_faculty   == nm)
  tibble(
    ` `                 = "▶",
    Name                = nm,
    Type                = row$person_type,
    Division            = coalesce(row$div_label, "Unknown"),
    `Med Ed Role`       = meded_roles_vec[i],
    `Evals Received`    = nrow(ev),
    `Avg Overall`       = if (nrow(ev) >= MIN_EVALUATIONS)
                            round(mean(ev$att_overall, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
                          else NA_real_,
    `Assessments Given` = nrow(ass)
  )
})

# (Filter options are populated dynamically in JS from the table data)

# ── DT callback JS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
callback_js <- paste0(
"var MIN_EVALS = ", MIN_EVALUATIONS, ";
var detailData = ", detail_json, ";

function escH(s) {
  if (!s) return '';
  return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;');
}

function buildDetail(d) {
  var avg = (d.avg_overall === null || d.avg_overall === undefined)
    ? '&lt; ' + MIN_EVALS + ' evals'
    : parseFloat(d.avg_overall).toFixed(2) + ' / 5';

  var h = '<div class=\"dp-wrap\">';

  // Type badge + Division badge + stat boxes
  var typeCol = (d.person_type === 'Fellow') ? '#5b6abf' : '#1a6496';
  h += '<div class=\"dp-div-badge\" style=\"background:' + typeCol + ';margin-right:0.4rem;\">'
     + escH(d.person_type) + '</div>';
  h += '<div class=\"dp-div-badge\">' + escH(d.division) + '</div>';
  h += '<div class=\"dp-stats\">'
     + '<div class=\"dp-stat\"><div class=\"dp-val\">' + d.n_evals + '</div><div class=\"dp-lbl\">Evals Received</div></div>'
     + '<div class=\"dp-stat\"><div class=\"dp-val\">' + avg + '</div><div class=\"dp-lbl\">Avg Overall</div></div>'
     + '<div class=\"dp-stat\"><div class=\"dp-val\">' + d.n_assess + '</div><div class=\"dp-lbl\">Assessments Given</div></div>'
     + '</div>';

  // Domain scores vs division average
  if (d.has_domains && d.domains && d.domains.length > 0) {
    h += '<div class=\"dp-section\"><div class=\"dp-sec-hd\">Domain Scores vs Division Average</div>'
       + '<table class=\"dp-dtbl\">';
    d.domains.forEach(function(dm) {
      if (dm.score === null || dm.score === undefined) return;
      var pct  = Math.min(parseFloat(dm.score) / 5 * 100, 100).toFixed(1);
      var dpct = (dm.div !== null && dm.div !== undefined)
                  ? Math.min(parseFloat(dm.div) / 5 * 100, 100).toFixed(1) : null;
      var diff = (dm.div !== null && dm.div !== undefined)
                  ? parseFloat(dm.score) - parseFloat(dm.div) : null;
      var diffStr = diff !== null ? ((diff >= 0 ? '+' : '') + diff.toFixed(2)) : '';
      var diffCol = diff !== null ? (diff >= 0 ? '#2a9d49' : '#d73027') : '#888';
      h += '<tr>'
         + '<td class=\"dp-dl\">' + escH(dm.label) + '</td>'
         + '<td class=\"dp-db\"><div class=\"dp-bg\">'
         +   '<div class=\"dp-fill\" style=\"width:' + pct + '%\"></div>'
         +   (dpct !== null ? '<div class=\"dp-dline\" style=\"left:' + dpct + '%\"></div>' : '')
         + '</div></td>'
         + '<td class=\"dp-ds\">' + parseFloat(dm.score).toFixed(2) + '</td>'
         + '<td class=\"dp-dd\" style=\"color:' + diffCol + '\">' + diffStr + '</td>'
         + '</tr>';
    });
    h += '</table>'
       + '<div class=\"dp-lgd\"><span class=\"dp-lgd-bar\"></span>&nbsp;Score &nbsp;|&nbsp; '
       + '<span class=\"dp-lgd-line\"></span>&nbsp;Div avg &nbsp;|&nbsp; Diff = vs div avg</div>'
       + '</div>';
  }

  // Feedback
  h += '<div class=\"dp-section dp-fb\">';
  h += '<div class=\"dp-fbc dp-plus\"><div class=\"dp-sec-hd\">&#10003; Strengths</div>';
  if (d.plus && d.plus.length > 0) {
    d.plus.forEach(function(t) { h += '<div class=\"dp-q\">' + escH(t) + '</div>'; });
  } else { h += '<em class=\"dp-none\">None recorded this year</em>'; }
  h += '</div>';

  h += '<div class=\"dp-fbc dp-delta\"><div class=\"dp-sec-hd\">&#9651; Growth Areas</div>';
  if (d.delta && d.delta.length > 0) {
    d.delta.forEach(function(t) { h += '<div class=\"dp-q\">' + escH(t) + '</div>'; });
  } else { h += '<em class=\"dp-none\">None recorded this year</em>'; }
  h += '</div>';
  h += '</div>'; // dp-fb

  // Feedback on Your Feedback synthesis (from AI analysis of free-text comments)
  if (d.synthesis_html) {
    h += '<div class=\"dp-section dp-synthesis\">'
       + '<div class=\"dp-sec-hd\">Notes on Feedback</div>'
       + '<div class=\"dp-synth-body\">' + d.synthesis_html + '</div>'
       + '</div>';
  }

  h += '</div>'; // dp-wrap
  return h;
}

// ── Multi-select filter logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// col indices: ▶=0, Name=1, Type=2, Division=3, Med Ed Role=4, Evals=5, Avg=6, Assessments=7
$.fn.dataTable.ext.search.push(function(settings, data, dataIndex) {
  if (!document.getElementById('pd-div-filter')) return true;

  var selDivs = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll('#pd-div-filter option:checked')
  ).map(function(o) { return o.value; });

  var selRoles = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll('#pd-meded-filter option:checked')
  ).map(function(o) { return o.value; });

  var selTypes = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll('#pd-type-filter option:checked')
  ).map(function(o) { return o.value; });

  var synthOnly = document.getElementById('pd-synth-filter') &&
                  document.getElementById('pd-synth-filter').checked;

  var typeOk = selTypes.length === 0 || selTypes.indexOf(data[2]) !== -1;
  var divOk  = selDivs.length  === 0 || selDivs.indexOf(data[3]) !== -1;
  var roleStr = String(data[4] || '');
  var roleOk  = selRoles.length === 0 || selRoles.some(function(r) {
    return roleStr.split('; ').indexOf(r) !== -1;
  });

  var synthOk = true;
  if (synthOnly) {
    var name = String(data[1] || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').trim();
    synthOk = !!(detailData[name] && detailData[name].synthesis_html);
  }

  return typeOk && divOk && roleOk && synthOk;
});

// ── Populate filter dropdowns directly (DOMContentLoaded has already fired) ──
var typeSel  = document.getElementById('pd-type-filter');
var divSel   = document.getElementById('pd-div-filter');
var mededSel = document.getElementById('pd-meded-filter');
var synthChk = document.getElementById('pd-synth-filter');
var clrBtn   = document.getElementById('pd-filter-clear');

var types = [], divs = [], mededs = [];
table.rows().every(function() {
  var d     = this.data();
  var t     = String(d[2] || '').trim();
  var v     = String(d[3] || '').trim();
  var roles = String(d[4] || '').split('; ');
  if (t && types.indexOf(t) === -1) types.push(t);
  if (v && divs.indexOf(v)  === -1) divs.push(v);
  roles.forEach(function(r) {
    r = r.trim();
    if (r && mededs.indexOf(r) === -1) mededs.push(r);
  });
});
types.sort().forEach(function(t) {
  var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = t; o.textContent = t;
  typeSel.appendChild(o);
});
divs.sort().forEach(function(d) {
  var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = d; o.textContent = d;
  divSel.appendChild(o);
});
mededs.sort().forEach(function(r) {
  var o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = r; o.textContent = r;
  mededSel.appendChild(o);
});

typeSel.addEventListener('change',   function() { table.draw(); });
divSel.addEventListener('change',    function() { table.draw(); });
mededSel.addEventListener('change',  function() { table.draw(); });
if (synthChk) synthChk.addEventListener('change', function() { table.draw(); });
if (clrBtn)   clrBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
  Array.from(typeSel.options).forEach(function(o)  { o.selected = false; });
  Array.from(divSel.options).forEach(function(o)   { o.selected = false; });
  Array.from(mededSel.options).forEach(function(o) { o.selected = false; });
  if (synthChk) synthChk.checked = false;
  table.draw();
});

// ── Row expand/collapse ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
table.on('click', 'tbody tr', function() {
  var row = table.row(this);
  if (!row.length) return;
  var name = String(row.data()[1] || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,'').trim();
  var d = detailData[name];

  if (row.child.isShown()) {
    row.child.hide();
    $(this).find('td:first').text('\\u25b6');
    $(this).removeClass('dp-open');
  } else {
    var content = d
      ? buildDetail(d)
      : '<em style=\"padding:1rem;display:block\">No data for ' + escH(name) + '</em>';
    row.child('<td colspan=\"99\" style=\"padding:0;border-top:none\">' + content + '</td>').show();
    $(this).find('td:first').text('\\u25bc');
    $(this).addClass('dp-open');
  }
});
")
```

```{=html}
<style>
/* ── Detail panel ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.dp-wrap { padding:1rem 1.25rem; background:#f8f9fa; border-bottom:2px solid #dee2e6; }

.dp-div-badge { display:inline-block; background:#1a6496; color:white;
                font-size:0.75rem; padding:0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius:10px;
                margin-bottom:0.6rem; font-weight:600; }

.dp-stats { display:flex; gap:1rem; margin-bottom:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.dp-stat  { background:white; border-radius:6px; padding:0.6rem 1rem;
            border-left:3px solid #2c7bb6; min-width:130px; }
.dp-val   { font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700; color:#2c7bb6; }
.dp-lbl   { font-size:0.75rem; color:#666; margin-top:0.1rem; }

.dp-section   { margin-bottom:1rem; }
.dp-sec-hd    { font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; color:#444; text-transform:uppercase;
                letter-spacing:0.05em; margin-bottom:0.45rem;
                border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0; padding-bottom:0.2rem; }

.dp-dtbl  { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:0.83rem; }
.dp-dtbl tr:hover { background:#e8f0f8; }
.dp-dl    { width:170px; padding:0.2rem 0.4rem; font-weight:500; }
.dp-db    { padding:0.2rem 0.4rem; min-width:180px; }
.dp-bg    { height:11px; background:#e0e0e0; border-radius:6px;
            position:relative; overflow:visible; }
.dp-fill  { height:100%; background:#2c7bb6; border-radius:6px;
            position:absolute; top:0; left:0; }
.dp-dline { position:absolute; width:2px; height:19px; top:-4px;
            background:#e74c3c; border-radius:1px; }
.dp-ds    { width:48px; padding:0.2rem 0.4rem; text-align:right; font-weight:600; }
.dp-dd    { width:56px; padding:0.2rem 0.4rem; text-align:right; font-size:0.78rem; }

.dp-lgd   { font-size:0.72rem; color:#888; margin-top:0.3rem; }
.dp-lgd-bar  { display:inline-block; width:22px; height:9px; background:#2c7bb6;
               border-radius:3px; vertical-align:middle; }
.dp-lgd-line { display:inline-block; width:2px; height:13px; background:#e74c3c;
               vertical-align:middle; }

.dp-fb    { display:flex; gap:1rem; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.dp-fbc   { flex:1; min-width:200px; }
.dp-q     { font-size:0.82rem; color:#333; padding:0.3rem 0.5rem; margin-bottom:0.3rem;
            border-left:3px solid #ccc; background:white; border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;
            line-height:1.45; }
.dp-plus  .dp-q  { border-left-color:#2a9d49; }
.dp-delta .dp-q  { border-left-color:#e67e22; }
.dp-none  { font-size:0.8rem; color:#aaa; font-style:italic; }

/* Synthesis section */
.dp-synthesis .dp-synth-body { font-size:0.84rem; line-height:1.5; }

tbody tr { cursor:pointer; }
tbody tr.dp-open > td:first-child { color:#1a6496; font-weight:bold; }

/* ── Filter panel ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pd-filter-panel {
  display:flex; gap:1.5rem; align-items:flex-start;
  padding:1rem 1.25rem; background:#f0f4f8; border-radius:6px;
  margin-bottom:1.25rem; flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.pd-filter-group label {
  display:block; font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:600; color:#555;
  margin-bottom:0.3rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em;
}
.pd-filter-select {
  min-width:180px; padding:0.3rem 0.5rem; font-size:0.84rem;
  border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; background:white;
}
.pd-filter-hint {
  font-size:0.73rem; color:#888; font-style:italic; margin-top:0.3rem;
}
.pd-filter-actions { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.4rem; align-self:flex-end; }
</style>
```

))

## Overview

```{r summary-boxes}
overall_label <- if (is.na(dept_overall)) "—" else sprintf("%.2f / 5", dept_overall)
n_divs_present <- length(unique(pd_people$fac_div[!is.na(pd_people$fac_div)]))

boxes <- list(
  list(val = as.character(n_faculty),    lbl = "Faculty",              sub = "active this year",              col = "#2c7bb6"),
  list(val = as.character(n_fellows),    lbl = "Fellows",              sub = "active this year",              col = "#5b6abf"),
  list(val = as.character(n_total_evals),lbl = "Evaluations Received", sub = current_year,                    col = "#2c7bb6"),
  list(val = overall_label,             lbl = "Dept Avg Overall",      sub = "faculty + fellows, out of 5",   col = "#2c7bb6")
)

box_html <- paste(sapply(boxes, function(b) sprintf(
  '<div style="background:#f8f9fa;border-left:4px solid %s;border-radius:4px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;">
    <div style="font-size:1.85rem;font-weight:700;color:%s;">%s</div>
    <div style="font-size:0.88rem;font-weight:600;color:#333;margin-top:0.15rem;">%s</div>
    <div style="font-size:0.76rem;color:#888;margin-top:0.1rem;">%s</div>
  </div>', b$col, b$col, b$val, b$lbl, b$sub
)), collapse = "\n")

knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
  '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;">%s</div>',
  box_html
))
```

## Teaching Activity

```{r assess-summary-callout}
avg_per_person <- if (n_people > 0) round(n_total_assess / n_people, 1) else 0
n_active_assessors <- length(unique(
  all_person_assess_curr$ass_faculty[all_person_assess_curr$ass_faculty %in% all_person_names]
))

knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
  '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0.75rem;margin-bottom:1.25rem;">
    <div style="background:#e8f4fd;border-radius:8px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;text-align:center;">
      <div style="font-size:2.1rem;font-weight:800;color:#1a6496;">%d</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;color:#333;margin-top:0.2rem;">Total Assessments</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#666;margin-top:0.15rem;">%s</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background:#f5f5f5;border-radius:8px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;text-align:center;">
      <div style="font-size:2.1rem;font-weight:800;color:#555;">%.1f</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;color:#333;margin-top:0.2rem;">Avg per Person</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#666;margin-top:0.15rem;">%s</div>
    </div>
    <div style="background:#fff8e1;border-radius:8px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;text-align:center;">
      <div style="font-size:2.1rem;font-weight:800;color:#b7760a;">%d</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;color:#333;margin-top:0.2rem;">People Assessed</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#666;margin-top:0.15rem;">at least once this year</div>
    </div>
  </div>',
  n_total_assess, current_year,
  avg_per_person, current_year,
  n_active_assessors
))
```

```{r assess-by-level-chart}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 6
#| out-width: "100%"

if (nrow(assess_by_level) > 0) {
  lvl_order <- c("Intern", "PGY-2", "PGY-3", "Rotator", "Graduated")
  assess_by_level |>
    mutate(level_label = factor(level_label, levels = rev(lvl_order))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = n, y = level_label)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6", width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.3, size = 3.5, color = "#333") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Assessments by Resident Level — %s", current_year),
         x = "Number of Assessments", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("*No assessment records found in the current academic year.*")
}
```
